title: Bình minh xám
about: Round x5 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa"): a grey dawn after a long night: still dark, but the choir and strings slowly open from G minor to E flat and B flat, the glass singing a little higher each time. G minor at 52 bpm. An original piece.
